AboutPage.bridgeSummary: I bridge together Development, UI/UX Design, Product, Marketing, Technology, and Management.
AboutPage.body1: I'm Nick Preziosi, a UI/UX leader and front-end developer with a background spanning product design, development, marketing, and digital strategy.
AboutPage.body2: I started my career in marketing before moving deeper into development and UI/UX. That multidisciplinary background shapes how I work today —balancing user needs, business goals, thoughtful design, and the technical systems required to bring products to life.
AboutPage.name: Nick Preziosi
